spookyfriends.configuration.addWhitelist: Add the players from the whitelist to the Friends list [default: true]
The chance for a Friend to spawn with block(s) [default: 0.5]
spookyfriends.configuration.blocks.toolt:
A list of blocks and max amount a Friend can spawn with
Format: "<block>,<max_amount>" (optional)
spookyfriends.configuration.fakeStepsCha: Chance of fake footsteps while the player is underground (1 out of X, 0 to disable) [default: 1000]
spookyfriends.configuration.fakeStepsCoo: Cooldown in seconds between fake footsteps, plus a random extra of up to the same amount [default: 300]
spookyfriends.configuration.friends.tool:
A list of users who can be chosen when it spawns a distant friend.
Format: "<username>" or "<username>,<base64 texture>" (optional)
